subject: environmental-science
title: UK Nature: Coasts & Sea Life
welcome_lead: From rock pools to seabird cliffs — the UK coast is a wildlife hotspot.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: UK coast wildlife, puffins, seals.
final_note: The coast is where land and sea swap secrets.

concepts.def: Marine mammal sunbathing on UK beaches.
Pool left at low tide on rocky shores.

walkthroughs.body_html: Skomer, Bempton and Lundy host huge colonies of puffins, guillemots and gannets each summer. Loud, smelly, brilliant.
At low tide, rock pools reveal crabs, anemones, starfish and tiny fish. Wear grippy shoes and put everything back where you find it.
Grey seals live around UK shores. Keep a respectful distance — too-close visitors stress them.
